titulo: A channel pipeline with sources on screen
hero_alt: Workstation with monitors showing a transcript, source table, and a vertical video being assembled.
lead: The finviral, saudeviral, and advviral radar tools automatically make one video a day about what the biggest names in the niche have published, with the source for every number on screen. r7e and promoavatar make reels and videos for each audience. Before you build your own, see the whole pipeline and what each tool does.
objetivo: explain the six stations in a channel pipeline with sources, and choose which tool your channel starts with.

aprende.t: The six stations in the pipeline
What each tool does: r7e, promoavatar, and the radar tools
Why the queue and gate come before automation

secoes.sub: The same engine powers all three: only the channels, rules, and schedule change.

nos.detalhe: Lists videos from the channels in canais.json (metadata only, using yt-dlp), downloads the audio, and transcribes it on your own computer with inemavox (Whisper large-v3). No paid API is used at this step.

itens.t: Who said it and the video

nos.detalhe: The agent reads the transcripts and records each number or fact with who said it, the video ID, the date, and the exact transcript excerpt. This is the only source material the script can use.
Using your subscription and no API, claude -p writes the lines and visuals to roteiro.json and the approval text to legenda.txt, always based on the database.

itens.t: Is the excerpt in the transcript?

nos.detalhe: checar.py checks whether each excerpt from the database is actually in the transcript, whether the numbers in the spoken lines are spelled out, and whether the niche disclaimer and CTA appear. If it fails, the script gets one revision. If it fails again, the video is not made.

Nei's avatar comes from the HeyGen studio (subscription). If that fails, the fallback is a version with a photo and local voice. The stage is a page rendered frame by frame, with counters, word-by-word captions, and the source on screen in every scene.

The video goes to the YouTube channel through yt-pubx and always to the Telegram bot. The bot receives one of three things: the video, "no topic" (a slow day doesn't become a video), or "failed at X".

secoes.volta: Failed review: the script gets one revision
secoes.legenda: Without a queue and a gate, automating social media means posting the wrong thing faster. That's why this is step 4: it uses the terminal, assistant, and queue from the previous steps.

rolagem_fim.texto: Collection and transcription feed the database; the database constrains the script; review blocks anything without a source; the avatar and stage assemble the video; publishing always lets you know. Each station is a lesson in this course.

secoes.sub: Click each one. They are all open repositories from INEMA.

texto: You provide a strong idea, and get a 30 to 40 second 9:16 reel using the 7-step trigger script, from the number hook to the request for a comment.
r7e (reel7etapas) provided the script; r7ex is the new standard (10/18/2026), with a TV news finish. Lesson 2 of this course.

exemplo.texto: One idea for the day → one reel with an avatar, panels timed to the spoken lines, and "comment WORD" at the end.

texto: One topic becomes a script for each of 12 audiences (young people, adults 40+, entrepreneurs, educators…), each with its own trigger and channel.
The bot writes and stops: you approve before spending on the avatar and rendering. Lesson 6.

exemplo.texto: "/promoavatar <assunto>" → 12 scripts, 2 gates, 12 reels delivered to each audience’s channel.

texto: The same topic yields three scripts for the same audience: reach (to be shared), authority (to be saved), and promotional (to connect a pain point to a solution).
Recommended publishing order: reach → authority → promotional. Lesson 6.

exemplo.texto: "| alvos=jovens-alc,jovens-aut,jovens-pro" → three videos for young people, with different CTAs.

texto: They watch what the biggest names in the niche have published, check every number against the transcript, and publish one short video a day, with the source on screen and the niche disclaimer.
Finance, health, and law use the same engine; only the channel list, rules, and schedule change. Lessons 3, 4, 5, and 7.

exemplo.texto: Monday-to-Friday timer → a 40- to 60-second video about what they said yesterday and the day before, or "no topic".

secoes.sub: Copy and fill this out before any automation. It guides the rest of the course.

abas.html:
• finviral: finance, Anbima FInfluence ranking Top 10, runs at 02:00, disclaimer "not investment advice".
  • saudeviral: health, doctors, nutritionists, and psychologists with the largest audiences, runs at 05:00, disclaimer "does not replace a medical consultation" and SEM CONSENSO label.
  • advviral: law, 10 YouTube lawyers, runs at 08:00, disclaimer "does not replace advice from a lawyer".

The schedules differ so they don’t compete for the GPU and HeyGen.

secoes.sub: r7e, promoavatar, and your niche’s viral channel, in under two minutes.
The explanation appears after you answer.

perguntas.p: A radar script failed review twice in a row. What happens?
opcoes: The video is released anyway, with a disclaimer.
The video isn’t made, and the bot receives the failure notice.
The agent replaces the numbers with rounded figures.
The script keeps going back for revision until it passes.
perguntas.explica: If it fails once, the script goes back for revision. If it fails again, the video isn’t made. Better a day without a video than a number without a source.

perguntas.p: You want the same topic in three versions for the same audience: one to be shared, one to be saved, and one that leads to the course. Which tool?
perguntas.explica: promoavatar3 makes three videos per audience: reach, authority, and promotional. promoavatar makes one video for each of 12 audiences.

perguntas.p: What does the bot on Telegram receive on a morning when the niche channels haven’t published anything relevant?
opcoes: Nothing: silence means there was no video.
A short video with whatever is available, even if it’s weak.
perguntas.explica: The bot always receives one of three things: the video, "no topic," or "failed at X." A slow news day doesn’t become a video, and silence is never the answer.

perguntas.p: Why do finviral, saudeviral, and advviral run at different times (02:00, 05:00, and 08:00)?
opcoes: Because each audience wakes up at a different time.
So they don’t compete for the GPU and HeyGen on the same machine.
Because YouTube only allows one upload per hour.
perguntas.explica: All three use the same engine on the same machine. Separate schedules keep two from competing for the GPU and avatar studio at the same time.
